integrity: Full symbolic proof from cited published lemmas and Dirichlet’s theorem; finite supplementary checks are not infinite certification. Independent audit was not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles the prime-summand density only, not the square-summand density or the pointwise conjecture. No effective uniform bound or decay rate is claimed. Originality is relative to inspected literature; a missed equivalent result remains possible.
title: Density-zero exceptions for a Zumkeller number plus a prime
